title: Matthew 3:16-17 — Jesus' baptism: the Spirit like a dove and the Father's voice
summary: Matthew 3:16-17 quoted in English with colour highlights: after Jesus is baptized the heavens open, the Spirit of God descends like a dove, and a voice says "This is My beloved Son". A closing line reads "John was present at Jesus' baptism".

text.text: 16 After being baptized, Jesus came up immediately from the water; and behold, the heavens were opened, and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove and lighting on Him,
17 and behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well-pleased.”
John was present at Jesus’ baptism

uncertain: Colour meanings (Jesus/Son/Him/whom in red; Spirit and dove in gold; My, I, God letters in blue/red/gold) are not explained on the slide
